description:
Precomputed routing + FP8 FP32-block-scaled payloads -> expert SwiGLU FFN and weighted reduction.  Explicit FP8 intermediate semantics; see reference.py module documentation.

Production entry: flashinfer.trtllm_fp8_block_scale_routed_moe; fixed source revision d849eca46875d3561fa48f6093936304580a1698.

Parameter domain: shape_range.json defines dynamic request ranges and correlated model/ABI constraints; shape_cases.json fixes 10 representative workloads, not the complete support domain. Tokens/capacity vary through 8192; routing profiles and masked/empty routes remain explicit. Qwen3-30B H2048/I768/E128, Qwen3-235B H4096/I1536/E128 and DeepSeek-V3 H7168/I2048/E256 retain their declared expert-TP/EP partitions. No measured traffic weights are claimed. Existing GPU evidence covers only the unchanged fixed sample, not every point in this dynamic domain.

Input construction: FC1 [E_local,2*I_local,H], FC2 [E_local,H,I_local], with I_local=I_model/expert_tp and E_local=E_model/EP. Qwen3-30B H2048/I768/E128/top8 and Qwen3-235B H4096/I1536/E128/top8 include full-I cases. DeepSeek-V3 H7168/I2048/E256/top8 uses TP8 (I_local256) here. TP-sharded results are partial expert outputs: the caller must sum across TP outside this local callable; EP dispatch/combine, where present, is inside its declared boundary. Model geometry does not claim identical model router policy, activation or deployed precision. Per-channel activation gains .65..1.35 and weight row gains .7..1.3 precede existing payload/scale quantization; FC2 weights use full-I fan-in scaling. Router logits use shared eight-token features, token noise and expert biases; topk IDs and renormalized weights derive from the same logits. Balanced, moderate skew, concentrated hotspot, invalid/empty and multi-rank remote-biased routing remain distinct. Input quantization temporaries are bounded to one expert.

Numerical contract reference-materialization-v1-20261013: Existing payload/scale decoding and FC1/activation QDQ are retained. Each route FC2 is accumulated in independent FP32, then materialized as BF16 (round-to-nearest-even) before multiplying its routing weight and summing routes in FP32. The final output uses its declared storage dtype. This boundary does not prescribe approximate activation or reciprocal instructions. Independent FP32 between specified storage/QDQ boundaries; TF32 disabled. Unchanged upstream torch.allclose(reference_float, candidate_float, atol=0.01, rtol=0.05). Prior version: evidence/reference-revision-20261013/before.tar.gz. Source and causal evidence: docs/production-bench-v3/CORE_NUMERICAL_ATTRIBUTION_20261013.md.

validation.correctness_scope: Original library, validation_scope=sampled, SM103; fixed shape IDs 0-9, at most 2 recorded seeds per shape. 采样通过. Counts={'passed': 20}. No prior patched results inherited. Shared-GPU timings are execution checks only.

limitations: No deployment-specific frequency or device-time weight is claimed.

real_inputs.reason: General source-derived shapes and stored-precision synthetic payloads; real traffic is not part of this core contract.
